PUPPY GAME — ACTIVITY (8 minutes)
SETUP (1 min): Pick a confident, energetic student to be "The AI Puppy." Give this student a secret verbal briefing: "Your job is to guess the secret action I've whispered to the class. Try anything. Keep going until you crack it."
Whisper to the rest of the class: "The secret action is: sit down, stand up, turn around." (A 3-step sequence works best.)
RUN THE GAME (5 min): Let the Puppy try. Class gives 👍 or 👎. Don't help. Let the Puppy struggle and iterate. This confusion IS the learning experience.
DEBRIEF (2 min): SAY: "What just happened? The Puppy had no instructions. Just feedback. And eventually — they cracked the pattern. THAT is Reinforcement Learning." SAY: "When you use ChatGPT or Google Assistant, there are teams of people who did EXACTLY what you just did — gave thumbs up and thumbs down to millions of AI responses. That's how it got so good."
KEY PHRASE TO WRITE ON BOARD: "Reinforcement Learning = Learning from feedback"
This activity is the most memorable moment of Module 1. Don't rush the debrief.
